name: Hyper
author: Digitalbase
description: Inspired by Raycast's Hyper Key for users moving from macOS to Omarchy. Turn Caps Lock into ✦ and create app keybindings to launch your apps. View, assign, overwrite, and remove keyboard shortcuts from a native bar panel.
